## Objectives

- Defeat 1 Elite Elite of the Withered Reach ([Swollen Stump](../monsters/swollen_stump.md), [Raider Boar](../monsters/raider_boar.md), [Swollen Dark Stump](../monsters/swollen_dark_stump.md), [War Mask](../monsters/war_mask.md), [Bone Hound](../monsters/bone_hound.md), [Swollen Axe Stump](../monsters/swollen_axe_stump.md), [Stone Hulk](../monsters/stone_hulk.md))

## Rewards

- 14,500 EXP
- 1,040 mesos
- +20 standing with Midbarium

The first time you complete it instead: 14,500 EXP, 2,000 mesos, [White Potion](../items/white_potion.md) x10, +15 standing with Midbarium, +30 standing with [Tavi](../npcs/tavi_uskari.md)
